feedback.problem:
Given that $x,y\in {C}^{3},$ compute the standard Hermitian inner product $⟨x,y⟩$ of the following two vectors.

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}-1+i \\ 1 \\ 2-i\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}1+i \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the definition of the standard Hermitian inner product, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y⟩ & ={x}_{1}\overset{―}{{y}_{1}}+{x}_{2}\overset{―}{{y}_{2}}+{x}_{3}\overset{―}{{y}_{3}} \\  & =(-1+i)\cdot (\overset{―}{1+i})+1\cdot \overset{―}{3}+(2-i)\cdot \overset{―}{1} \\  & =(-1+i)\cdot (1-i)+1\cdot 3+(2-i)\cdot 1 \\  & =2\text{i}+3+(2-i) \\  & =5+i.\end{aligned}
$$
